content.text:
Complaint from a customs broker, received 12 March: “You held a container for undeclared weight and the weight on your own scale was wrong.”

Reply sent: “Thank you. The scale has been checked and is correct.”

The scale has not been checked.

Crane 2: fault, 11 March, 14:20. Crane 2: fault, 12 March, 09:05. Crane 2: fault, 13 March, 16:40. Gate B camera: working, 11 to 13 March. The cause of the cranes has not been found. The camera is fine.
